## Compatible Games:

- **Grand Theft Auto III (US v1.0)**

## Installation

- Download and install [GTA III Widescreen Fix](http://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#gta3), it includes required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
- Download [III.Project2DFX](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/III.VC.SA.IV.Project2DFX/releases/download/gtavc/III.Project2DFX.zip) and put the asi and ini files to scripts folder.
